from pathlib import Path

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    width = len(grid[0])
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(value == 2 for value in row))
    top_row = next(r for r in range(divider) if any(value not in (0, 2) for value in grid[r]))
    bottom_row = next(r for r in range(len(grid) - 1, divider, -1) if any(value not in (0, 2) for value in grid[r]))
    top = grid[top_row]
    bottom = grid[bottom_row]
    for c in range(width):
        if top[c] != 0 and top[c] == bottom[c]:
            for r in range(top_row + 1, divider):
                out[r][c] = 4
    return out
'''
